page.layout: One printed page. At the top, a running head and page number. Below them, a chronological table in two blocks divided by a horizontal rule, with columns for indiction, year, dominical letters, Nabonassar year, Christian and Diocletian dates, and Julian year. Below the table, one full-width paragraph of text, with its note mark "a" at the start. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Ind. | An.Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabonafari. Feriæ. | Christi. Diocletiani[?]
main_text.p: {a} Hoc anno Christi trecentesimo duodecimo, mense Septembri, quinquennalia dedit Constantinus Magnus, postquam quadriennium absolutum ef-fet ab ipsius Encaeniis, quae peractae fuerant anno Christi 308, VIII kal. Octobris. A primorum igitur quinquennalium panegyri, & quidem ex ante diem VIII kal. Octobris, labente anno Iuliano 357, & Christi 312 incipiunt Indictiones Constantinianae, quando Constantinus & Licinius Augg. secundum consulatum gesserunt, sicut etiam annotarunt Fasti Graeci, quos citat Onufrius, hisce verbis, Ἰνδικτιώνων Κωνσταντινιακῶν ἐντεῦθεν ἀρχή[?], id est, hinc Indictionum Constanti-niana-

page.notes: The "a" note mark has no visible counterpart in the table. The Greek phrase in the note is hard to read and is only approximate. The Greek line "Ἰνδικτιώνων Κωνσταντινιακῶν ἐντεῦθεν ἀρχή" is uncertain throughout. The table header line is partly uncertain. The paragraph continues beyond the page, ending with the hyphenated "niana-".
